name: SeedProd
summary: Drag-and-drop page and theme builder plugin for WordPress: landing pages, coming-soon and maintenance pages, full website kits and a theme builder, plus an AI builder that drafts a site from a description.
best_for: WordPress site owners and small businesses who want to build landing pages, coming-soon pages or a full theme with drag and drop instead of code
skip_if: you do not use WordPress and want a hosted builder that includes hosting, or you only want to pay the introductory price and not the full renewal
honest_knock: The prices on the pricing page are first-year discounts; renewals are at full price, which is double on most plans, and the terms say renewals are not refundable. It only works on WordPress, so you also need hosting and a WordPress install. The theme builder, needed for a full website rather than landing pages, starts on Plus.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · introductory first-year price, 1 site, normally $79 a year
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-04 on seedprod.com/pricing, US dollars) SeedProd is a WordPress plugin sold as a yearly licence, and the prices on the pricing page are introductory: the page says all renewals are at full price. Basic costs $39.50 for the first year, normally $79, for 1 site with 50 templates and the drag-and-drop builder. Plus costs $99.50, normally $199, for 3 sites and adds full website kits, the theme builder and email marketing integrations. Pro costs $199.50, normally $399, for 5 sites and adds 300+ templates, dynamic text, Zapier integrations and priority support. Elite costs $239.60, normally $599, for 100 sites and adds WooCommerce and Easy Digital Downloads support and domain mapping. Every licence comes with a 14-day money-back guarantee. Separately, the homepage offers an AI builder that creates up to 3 websites free, without a card.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 22 November 2026 in WordPress Playground, a temporary WordPress site that runs in the browser, with the free SeedProd Lite plugin (version 6.20.13) from WordPress.org and the interface in English. We skipped the setup wizard, created a landing page from the blank template, added a headline, a button and a paragraph of text by drag and drop, published it and opened it on the front end. We paid nothing and opened the Basic checkout only to read the price.
findings: Setup: no SeedProd account is needed for Lite. The welcome screen offers a setup wizard that sends you to SeedProd.com; we skipped it. The dashboard lists Coming Soon, Maintenance and Landing Pages as free, and Website Builder, Login Page and 404 Page as PRO.
Templates: the picker mixes free and PRO templates. A banner offers 10 more free templates in exchange for an email address.

Builder: dragging blocks onto the page worked, though two of our drops landed in the wrong place, once as the word Button inside the text block. Headline, Text, List, Button, Image, Video and Custom HTML were open; Optin Form, Countdown, Tabs, Social Sharing and Animated Headline were locked.
Connections: in the Connect tab all 13 email marketing services, Zapier and reCAPTCHA were marked PRO. Only Google Analytics was open, so in Lite a landing page cannot send signups to a mailing list.

Publishing: the Publish button showed Your page has been published!, but the front end said the content was empty or had not been saved. After we clicked Save once more, the page appeared with our headline, button and text.

Checkout: on 22 November 2026 Basic was $39.50 for the first year (normally $79) for one site with 50 PRO templates; Plus was $99.50 for three sites and is the first plan whose card lists email marketing integrations. Renewals are at full price. The checkout asked for an email, first and last name and a card or PayPal, offered a $19 stock photo add on, and mentioned a 14 day money back guarantee. We did not pay.
